stage0033a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$五飛$$
「I've been waiting, $$ヒイロ$$.
　Somewhere no one can interfere, I'll finish this.」

stage0033a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is this the justice you speak of?」

stage0033a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$五飛$$
「This 'justice' called peace, built on sacrifice...!
　I just want to confirm if it's truly right!」

stage0033a_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$五飛$$
「What do you think you're doing!
　Don't interfere with my fight!」

stage0033a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$デキム$$
「The one interfering is you, $$張五飛$$」

stage0033a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$デキム$$...!
　Was this your doing!」

stage0033a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$デキム$$
「Your existence as a colony Gundam pilot
　was judged useful to us, but
　that ends here」

stage0033a_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$デキム$$
「You too denied 《$$オペレーション・メテオ$$》...
　The colony Gundams must be punished」

stage0033a_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$五飛$$
「A man who can't drop a grudge is small...!」

stage0033a_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$デキム$$
「That man moves the world...!
　Soon, everything will be ours!」

stage0033a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$デキム$$
「But first, I will eliminate every Gundam
　pilot who denied my true $$オペレーション・メテオ$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$カレン$$!
　Here to back up $$ヒイロ$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カレン$$
「Wrong, $$五飛$$!
　I came to bring you back!」

stage0033a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Me, you, everyone from A21...
　we all fought to win back peace!」

stage0033a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カレン$$
「So I won't let you keep fighting
　a sad fight like this!
　They all feel the same way!」

stage0033a_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$トロワ$$ and $$カトル$$, huh.」

stage0033a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Thanks to guiding $c to Brussels,
　we're late」

stage0033a_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カトル$$
「But they've already reached
　the first line of defense」

stage0033a_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$トロワ$$, $$カトル$$!
　You accept this false peace too!」

stage0033a_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カトル$$
「$$五飛$$, that's not ours to decide.
　It's for everyone in this world」

stage0033a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$トロワ$$
「What we must do isn't show a path by force」

stage0033a_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カレン$$
「You stubborn fool!
　You want to be stopped by force!」

stage0033a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Stay out of this, $$カレン$$.
　$$五飛$$ wants this fight with me」

stage0033a_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Neither $$ヒイロ$$ nor $$五飛$$ will listen」

stage0033a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カトル$$
「$$カレン$$,
　let's handle the enemies nearby」

stage0033a_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カレン$$
「...Fine.
　But I have something to tell $$五飛$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Same goes for $$カトル$$ and me」

stage0033a_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　$$デキム$$'s scheme doesn't matter!
　This is a fight between us!」

stage0033a_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Come, $$五飛$$.
　I'll settle this with you...and $$マリーメイア$$...!」

stage0033a_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$五飛$$
「Mankind never changed!
　Beating our enemies in each world...!
　Earth never changed!」

stage0033a_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But the more you fight,
　the more peace's sacrifices go to waste...!
　You must already know that!」

stage0033a_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$五飛$$
「So warriors are unneeded now!
　Soldiers who lived for war get cast aside!」

stage0033a_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$五飛$$
「Look at A21!
　They had no place in this world!」

stage0033a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カレン$$
「Wrong, $$五飛$$!
　The world didn't shun them!
　They turned their backs on it!」

stage0033a_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Sure, the world wasn't kind to them...!
　But doing what they did means denying
　everything they'd fought for!」

stage0033a_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Soldiers fought for peace, didn't they!
　Try believing in the world we have now!」

stage0033a_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$五飛$$
「I speak for those treated as weapons!
　I fight for every soldier, you too!」

stage0033a_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カトル$$
「That's not it, $$五飛$$!
　No one's a fighting machine...!
　They're human!」

stage0033a_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Whoever twists that with clever words
　is the enemy we must defeat」

stage0033a_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Admit it, $$五飛$$!
　If the war's over, soldiers can find
　a way to live as human beings!」

stage0033a_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$五飛$$
「You and I are fighting, like this!
　Isn't it in battle that you and I
　both feel truly alive!」

stage0033a_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$五飛$$
「You and I are the same kind!
　Only on the battlefield can we find
　any meaning in our existence!」

stage0033a_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't make $$ヒイロ$$ into a machine!」

stage0033a_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カレン$$
「Not just $$ヒイロ$$!
　$$デュオ$$, $$カトル$$, $$トロワ$$, $$キリコ$$ too!
　They're all human!」

stage0033a_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カレン$$
「Everyone gets angry, everyone laughs!
　$$ヒイロ$$ risks his life for $$リリーナ$$,
　no way he's a fighting machine!」

stage0033a_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're the same way, $$五飛$$!
　You're human, that's why you raged
　at $$ゼロ$$ and blocked the Tianzi's marriage!」

stage0033a_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カレン$$
「Everyone in A21 was the same!
　Twisted as it was, $$タクマ$$ fought for their sister!」

stage0033a_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カレン$$
「Everyone at $$２１世紀警備保障$$
　fought for their company, their city!
　Soldiers or salarymen, all human!」

stage0033a_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$カレン$$
「Everyone has their own reason to fight!
　Fighting isn't just about guns!
　Just living is a fight too!」

stage0033a_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Admit it, $$五飛$$!
　$$トレーズ$$ is gone!
　You're the one who defeated him!」

stage0033a_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$五飛$$
「Wrong!
　I'm still fighting him even now!
　To smash the false peace he left us!」

stage0033a_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$五飛$$
「I won't accept $$リリーナ$$ Peacecraft!
　The idea that discarding weapons and
　sealing soldiers away means peace is wrong!」

stage0033a_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$五飛$$
「That let Earth supremacists run wild,
　and fueled the colonies' anti-Federation movement!」

stage0033a_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$五飛$$
「Choosing not to fight becomes the soil
　that grows a bigger war!
　$$マリーメイア$$ is the proof!」

stage0033a_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So that's why you joined $$マリーメイア$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$五飛$$
「That becomes a warrior's anchor of the soul!」

stage0033a_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$! Why aren't you dodging!?」

stage0033a_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I understand your thinking...
　Earth and the colonies are twisted now...」

stage0033a_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But fighting to change it just repeats
　a history of sad, miserable war!」

stage0033a_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$五飛$$
「So colony people must endure in silence!?」

stage0033a_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The world changes by more than fighting...!
　You learned that in the $$再世戦争$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If we don't stop this war's tide here,
　soldiers like us will be needed again...
　people forced to give up everything!」

stage0033a_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then history's tragedies will never end!」

stage0033a_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カレン$$
（$$リリーナ$$ said $$ヒイロ$$ was raised
　from childhood to fight,
　trained as an agent...）

stage0033a_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カレン$$
（But maybe that wasn't the life
　$$ヒイロ$$ wanted for himself...）

stage0033a_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$, tell me.
　How many more must we kill?」

stage0033a_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How many more times, in the name
　of duty, must I take a life...」

stage0033a_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ won't tell me anything...
　Tell me, $$五飛$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$トロワ$$
「$$五飛$$'s Gundam has stopped moving」

stage0033a_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Then, let's clean up the rest」

stage0033a_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カトル$$
「He needs some time right now」

stage0033a_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$トロワ$$
「True.
　But we and the world can't afford to wait」

stage0033a_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$...
　If $$ゼロ$$ won't tell me anything,
　there's only one path for me」

stage0033a_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll find the future with my own hands」

stage0033a_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$五飛$$
「Find the future by my own strength...huh...」

stage0033a_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$五飛$$
「Don't get in my way!
　I'll deal with you later!」

stage0033a_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Stop it, $$五飛$$.
　It's painful just to watch」

stage0033a_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$五飛$$
「Don't you feel anything, $$トロワ$$!?
　Once the war ends, you become nothing,
　a man without even a name!」

stage0033a_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$トロワ$$
「True, before $$オペレーション・メテオ$$
　I had nothing」

stage0033a_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$トロワ$$
「But now, I'm $$トロワ・バートン$$.
　And, you wouldn't know this,
　but I'm a circus troupe's star too」

stage0033a_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$トロワ$$
「I'm not nameless anymore.
　Soldiers can find their own way to live too」

stage0033a_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$五飛$$
「How could I believe that...!
　My fight isn't over yet!」

stage0033a_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$カトル$$
「$$五飛$$, please stop this fighting!
　Didn't we fight to bring the war
　to an end!」

stage0033a_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$五飛$$
「This mess came from the false peace
　we built! So I'll break the world again!」

stage0033a_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カトル$$
「Do you think it's fine for lives
　to be lost for that!」

stage0033a_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then how do you save soldiers
　being killed while still alive!」

stage0033a_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$カトル$$
「That should be done some other way,
　not by fighting! Otherwise we're
　accepting endless war!」

stage0033a_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$五飛$$
「I seek that eternity!
　Even if it makes me evil!」

stage0033a_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カトル$$
「You're too kind, $$五飛$$...
　But that kindness needs to be aimed
　at something much bigger!」

stage0033a_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カレン$$
「Come back, $$五飛$$!
　$c needs your strength too!」

stage0033a_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$五飛$$
「And then you'll all just build
　another false peace again!」

stage0033a_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're saying our fight was a lie!?
　Then say that to the faces of the
　friends who died, if you can!」

stage0033a_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カレン$$
「If the peace we won turned out false,
　then make it real!
　Some way other than war!」

stage0033a_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$カレン$$
「I still hate $$トレーズ$$, even now!
　But he taught the whole world
　just how awful war is!」

stage0033a_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カレン$$
「For you, who beat him, to now do
　the same thing he did,
　that's just ridiculous!」

stage0033a_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$五飛$$
「Wrong...!
　I'm not $$トレーズ$$...!
　This is my fight!」

stage0033a_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　See the future with the Zero System!」

stage0033a_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$五飛$$
「If this false peace goes on as is,
　the world will be swallowed by a war
　worse than what $$マリーメイア$$ caused!」

stage0033a_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$五飛$$
「Why are you silent, $$ヒイロ$$!
　Didn't you master $$ゼロ$$!」

stage0033a_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I won't ask $$ゼロ$$ about the future」

stage0033a_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$...!
　I fight now to stop you!」
